**Do not intercept links for issues absent from the dashboard snapshot.** `resolveTrackerIssueId` uses registered-project metadata, but `useDrawerData` loads the selected issue only from the dashboard snapshot. A valid linked issue that is not in that snapshot can therefore open a drawer with the generic `Issue details` title and no issue record. Gate interception on the issue being present in the dashboard snapshot. Otherwise, keep the anchor's tracker navigation. The drawer's derived GitHub fallback covers known prefixes, but it does not cover every registered repository.

For issues absent from that snapshot, preserve the anchor’s normal tracker navigation rather than intercepting the click. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
✅ Confirmed as addressed by @eltmon

@eltmon The alternative fix addresses the dead-end concern without blocking issues that the server can backfill. Passing the original `href` to the drawer preserves tracker navigation when the issue never hydrates. I agree that snapshot presence should not gate interception. The generic `Issue details` title alone does not justify blocking drawer access when the tracker button remains usable.
